name: complete
description: Assert current tool-assisted or planned work is done. Call with a short summary after the last tool action, once every plan step is done or skipped, then write the final response text. A tool-assisted turn or a plan written in this turn (including resume / goal-mode turns) does not end without this call. Plain no-tool Q&A needs no call. The runtime verifies the assertion against the session plan: if steps are still pending/running/failed, the turn reopens instead of ending. A plan carried from an earlier turn does not bind until this turn updates it, but tool activity in the current turn still requires this assertion. It is single-use: a later tool action, `plan`, or `plan_update` invalidates it, so call it last.

summary.description: What was accomplished (one or two sentences).
